core.downloadData: Download Vanilla Data for Target Version
core.config.minecraftVersion: Minecraft version that generators, validation and previews target. `auto` detects it from `gradle.properties`, `fabric.mod.json`, `neoforge.mods.toml` or `pack.mcmeta`.
core.config.defaultNamespace: Namespace (mod id) for new resources. Empty = detected mod id.
core.config.displayLanguage: Language for item/block names in previews (`auto` follows VS Code's language).
core.config.allowDownload: Allow downloading vanilla data (textures, models, recipes, tags, names) for the target version from the community mirror of the official game files. Registries, tags and English names for 1.21.1, 1.21.11 and 26.3 are bundled for offline use.
core.config.autoDownload: Automatically download vanilla data for the detected version in the background the first time a project is opened.
core.config.baseUrl: Base URL of the mcmeta mirror used to download vanilla data.
explorer.welcome.noProject:
No Minecraft project detected in this workspace (no fabric.mod.json, neoforge.mods.toml, pack.mcmeta…).
[$(new-folder) Create Datapack](command:vscodecraft.explorer.createDatapack)
[$(symbol-color) Create Resource Pack](command:vscodecraft.explorer.createResourcePack)
[$(file-code) Create Mod Project](command:vscodecraft.explorer.createModProject)
[$(refresh) Re-detect](command:vscodecraft.refreshProjects)
Open an existing mod or pack folder, or learn more on the [welcome page](command:vscodecraft.explorer.welcome).
explorer.config.codeLens: Show an asset summary CodeLens (model, texture, lang, recipe…) above item and block registrations in Java/Kotlin files.
language.validateWorkspace: Validate Workspace Resources (ids, tags, models, textures)
language.renameLegacyFolder: Rename Legacy Folder to the 1.21+ Name
language.config.diagnostics: Check resource locations in data pack / resource pack JSON (unknown items, blocks, tags, missing models and textures, legacy folders, ingredient format).
language.config.validateWorkspace: Validate every data/assets JSON file of the workspace when the index is ready (not only open files).
language.config.strictUnknownNamespaces: Also report unknown ids in namespaces that the workspace does not own (e.g. `create:...` from other mods). Off by default to avoid false positives.
loot.copyToMod: Copy Vanilla Loot Table to My Mod
models.generateBlockSet: Generate Block Model Set (stairs, slab, wall…)
models.migrateItemDefinitions: Create Item Model Definitions from Item Models (1.21.4+)
recipes.openPreview: Open Recipe Preview to the Side
recipes.migrateFile: Migrate This Recipe to Target Version
schemas.config.versionChecks: Report version-compatibility problems in Minecraft JSON files that the JSON schemas can't detect (recipe types not available in the target version, `custom_model_data` format, removed components, `pack.mcmeta` format fields…).
textures.config.hoverPreview: Show the texture image when hovering texture ids (`block/stone`, `mymod:item/ruby`) in JSON files.
textures.config.gutterIcons: Show small texture icons in the gutter next to texture references in model JSON files.
translations.config.sortKeys: Sort translation keys alphabetically whenever the Lang Editor or the translation commands write a lang file. When off, the existing key order is kept and new keys are placed next to their `en_us` neighbours.
translations.config.autoSave: Save lang files automatically after edits made from the Lang Editor and translation commands (files open in a text editor stay unsaved).
translations.config.untranslatedMarker: Prefix added to English text copied into other locales (e.g. `[TODO] `). Empty: copy the English text as-is; the Lang Editor highlights values identical to `en_us` as untranslated.
translations.config.hover: Show hover previews of `§` formatted strings, JSON text components and the other locales of a key in lang files.
translations.config.colorPicker: Show the colour picker for string colours (`"color": "#RRGGBB"` and named text colours) in resource JSON files.
translations.config.decorations: Decorate `§` colour and formatting codes inside lang files.
